---
title: "Backtest Comparison"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
from _common import get_conn
from thirteen_f._legacy_dashboard.charts import cumulative_curve, drawdown_chart
from thirteen_f.web.queries import backtest_curves_df, backtest_metrics_df

conn = get_conn()
# run은 실행마다 누적되므로 전략별 최신 run만 비교 (backtest_metrics_df는 created_at DESC 정렬)
metrics = backtest_metrics_df(conn).drop_duplicates("strategy_name")
metrics
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
run_ids = metrics["run_id"].tolist()
curves = backtest_curves_df(conn, run_ids)
cumulative_curve(curves)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
drawdown_chart(curves)
```
